meta.name: hypothesis-generation
meta.description: Structured hypothesis formulation from observations. Use when you have experimental observations or data and need to formulate testable hypotheses with predictions, propose mechanisms, and design experiments to test them. Follows scientific method framework. For open-ended ideation use scientific-brainstorming; for automated LLM-driven hypothesis testing on datasets use hypogenic.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将观察转化为可检验的假设与实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有实验数据或观察结果，需要系统性地提出科学假设。
copy.tagline_en: Turn observations into testable hypotheses and experiments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have experimental data or observations and need to formulate scientific hypotheses systematically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的观察或数据，系统性地生成可检验的科学假说，包括提出机制、设计实验和预测结果，并输出一份带示意图的 LaTeX 报告。
howto.when: 当你需要从实验观察或数据出发，提出可检验的假说、设计实验或探索竞争性解释时触发。

say.text: 根据这些细胞实验数据，生成三个竞争性假说。
say.note: Claude 会搜索文献、提出假说并设计实验。

say.text: 帮我设计一个实验来检验这个假说。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体的实验方案和对照。

say.text: 列出这个现象可能的机制，并给出预测。
say.note: Claude 会生成多个假说及其可检验的预测。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will systematically generate testable scientific hypotheses from your observations or data, including proposing mechanisms, designing experiments, and formulating predictions, and output a LaTeX report with schematic figures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to formulate testable hypotheses from experimental observations or data, design experiments, or explore competing explanations.

say_en.text: Generate three competing hypotheses from these cell experiment data.
say_en.note: Claude will search literature, propose hypotheses, and design experiments.

say_en.text: Design an experiment to test this hypothesis.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a specific experimental plan and controls.

say_en.text: List possible mechanisms for this phenomenon and give predictions.
say_en.note: Claude will generate multiple hypotheses with testable predictions.
